title: Joomla Extension - joomlatools.com - Server-side request forgery in URL uploads in DOCman extension < 6.2.2 - The URL…
description: A server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability exists in the URL proxy and URL upload features of the DOCman extension for Joomla versions prior to 6.2.2. These features were accessible to users below manager level and could be exploited to make the server fetch arbitrary addresses, including internal or private network resources.
